changelog:
Initial release of the churn-prevention skill, focused on SaaS retention.

- Expert guidance on reducing voluntary and involuntary churn through tailored flows and proactive strategies.
- Structured cancel flow framework with integrated exit surveys and dynamic save offers.
- Covers dunning/failed payment recovery and post-cancel win-back best practices.
- Provides survey and offer templates, practical UI patterns, and best practices for each churn scenario.
- Includes recommendations for context-gathering to tailor retention advice to any SaaS business.
